editorial.blurb: A warmly elegant French-Mediterranean gem where fresh, beautifully plated seafood and refined cocktails meet genuinely attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the oysters and escargot to start — diners rave about their balance and buttery richness — then follow with the scallops or tuna crudo; ask your server (Kevin and Bobby are standouts) for cocktail recommendations like the St Tropez Spritz.
